lines.words: My darling, I love you to the moon and back
Fallin' for someone, isn't it so lovely?
Can make you go so crazy, and make you overthink
Tried to believe that you could never want me
For all the ghosts that haunt me, and baggage that I bring
But you held me in the dark
So I could feel you in the light
Fall into you
Cover me like rain
Ever since you
Nothin' is the same
Stars in your eyes
Like the sky, I fell through
All of me is yours to keep
Babe, I fall into you
I didn't hear your voice until the echo
But then it hit me, baby (it hit me, baby)
Like sirens in the wind (like sirens in the wind)
Gravity pulled me in, now I can't let go (now I can't let go)
Now I'm all yours, baby (now I'm all yours, baby)
Yours until the end (yours until the end)
You held me in the dark
So I could feel you in the light
Fall into you
Cover me like rain
Ever since you
Nothin' is the same
Stars in your eyes
Like the sky, I fell through
All of me is yours to keep
Babe, I fall into you
(Babe, I fall into you)
(Ooh, ooh)
(Ooh, ooh)
You held me in the dark
So I could feel you in the light
